turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, and the first thing I want to know is why I found out about my son's zero from my son.
Thanks for coming in.
That wasn't an answer, Hale. Why didn't anyone call me before that zero went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
So did I, before he saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call the parent before a mark goes in, so which rule were you following?
How has his semester been at home?
My house isn't on the table, Hale. You've dodged my question three times now, and I'm writing that down.
He seems tired in class lately.
Tired isn't a document. He's seventeen, he works twenty hours a week, and none of that is a reason to give him a zero.
I know he works at the grocery store.
Then you know exactly how much this semester matters to him. I'm going to ask once more: what do you actually have, Hale, or am I going upstairs?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
"Which was good." So he handed it in on time, and you gave him a zero for it. Fifteen minutes, Hale.
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Concerns aren't evidence, Hale. Name them, with dates, or this goes to the principal today.
The school's checker flagged it.

A machine flagged it. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and the company that sells these tools says the same thing in writing, which I have in my bag. So is there anything else, or did you zero my son on a machine's guess?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Not perfect." And you entered the zero anyway, before you called me. Ten minutes, Hale.
I also looked at the version history.
Then show me. Times, dates, what it says, on the screen where I can read it myself.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." Half the kids in this school do their homework at midnight, Hale, and mine works a shift first. That proves nothing unless you put exact times in front of me.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
He told me he wrote it over the weekend, so maybe he drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. "Two big pieces" means nothing to me without exact times and word counts on a screen, Hale.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
When, and did you write it down? And was that before or after the zero went in?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble explaining it." A seventeen-year-old put on the spot by his teacher after class, and you didn't answer my question about when. Five minutes, Hale.
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Then withdraw the zero. You can't say that while there's a zero in his gradebook.
What do you think should happen next?
You want me to decide your next step for you? The zero comes out today, I get an apology in writing, and nothing touches his record.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not you, Hale, and I'm not here to coach you. Two minutes.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.

A rewrite is what you offer when you think he did something, and in twenty minutes you haven't put one document in front of me. My terms are the zero comes out, I get a written apology for how this was handled, and nothing goes near his record. I'm going to the principal's office now, unless you have something to say first.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Private doesn't make it fair, Hale, and you still haven't shown me why he should sit it at all. The zero comes out first, then we can talk about anything else.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.

"If it holds up." So there's a version of this where something goes on his file, on the strength of a checker score and your impressions. I'll be in the principal's office, Hale, and you'll have my position in writing tonight.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email, Hale. The zero comes out, I get a written apology, and nothing goes near Owen's record.
Thanks for your time.
Don't thank me, Hale, I'm not done with this. Your principal will hear from me before I'm back at my desk.
